queries.schema: SELECT nspname AS name,nspowner::regrole::text AS owner,nspacl AS acl FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public'
queries.relations: SELECT c.relname AS name,c.relkind AS kind,c.relpersistence AS persistence,c.relowner::regrole::text AS owner,c.relacl AS acl,c.relrowsecurity AS row_security,c.relforcerowsecurity AS force_row_security,c.reloptions AS options,c.relispartition AS is_partition,pg_get_partkeydef(c.oid) AS partition_key,pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound,c.oid) AS partition_bound,CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('v','m') THEN pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) END AS view_definition FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY c.relname
queries.columns: SELECT c.relname AS relation,a.attnum AS number,a.attname AS name,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,a.attnotnull AS not_null,a.attidentity AS identity,a.attgenerated AS generated,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_value,a.attacl AS acl FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname='public' AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY c.relname,a.attnum
queries.constraints: SELECT conrelid::regclass::text AS relation,conname AS name,contype AS type,convalidated AS validated,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.connamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY relation,conname
queries.indexes: SELECT tablename AS relation,indexname AS name,indexdef AS definition FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename,indexname
queries.triggers: SELECT c.relname AS relation,t.tgname AS name,t.tgenabled AS enabled,t.tgisinternal AS internal,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) AS definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname
queries.functions: SELECT p.proname AS name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS args,p.proowner::regrole::text AS owner,p.proacl AS acl,p.proconfig AS config,encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') AS definition_sha256 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.prokind IN ('f','p') ORDER BY p.proname,args
queries.sequences: SELECT sequencename AS name,sequenceowner AS owner,data_type,start_value,min_value,max_value,increment_by,cycle,cache_size FROM pg_sequences WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY sequencename
queries.policies: SELECT tablename AS relation,policyname AS name,permissive,roles,cmd,qual,with_check FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename,policyname
queries.types: SELECT t.typname AS name,t.typtype AS kind,t.typcategory AS category,t.typowner::regrole::text AS owner,t.typacl AS acl,format_type(t.typbasetype,t.typtypmod) AS base_type,t.typnotnull AS not_null,t.typdefault AS default_value,t.typinput::regproc::text AS input,t.typoutput::regproc::text AS output FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY t.typname
queries.extensions: SELECT e.extname AS name,e.extversion AS version,e.extowner::regrole::text AS owner,e.extrelocatable AS relocatable,e.extconfig AS config,e.extcondition AS condition FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY e.extname
queries.enums: SELECT t.typname AS name,e.enumlabel AS label,e.enumsortorder AS position FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace JOIN pg_enum e ON e.enumtypid=t.oid WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY t.typname,e.enumsortorder

resultShape: Object.fromEntries(section -> query(sql).rows); preserve the returned row order and all fields
